text:
Samir Khanna: Heads-up: Legal flagged the line in the SOC2 doc that says 'we retain audit logs for 7 years'. That reads like a promise. Can we rework to talk about 'audit artifacts' and show how customers can export evidence and manage retention? PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/inference/docs/pull/1423

Jules Park: Agreed. Suggest split: 1) operational telemetry (default short retention), 2) exported audit artifacts (customer-managed retention guidance). Also add a small migration note for SDK v2 since the export API moved namespaces.

Nina Gomez: Draft language attempt: "Redwood retains operational telemetry for short-term service health; customers may export audit artifacts for compliance and retain them according to their policies. Hosted: operational telemetry retained 90 days; evidence exportable and recommended to be retained per your regulatory needs (3+ years typical). Private: retention is controlled by the customer." Thoughts?

Legal Bot: That framing is better. Please avoid absolute statements like "we will retain X for Y years". Use terms like "recommended" and "exportable". For SOC2, suggest saying "we recommend retaining evidence for a minimum of 3 years; for certain regulated industries 6-7 years may be appropriate."

Samir Khanna: OK. Can we include two SDK snippets: one curl and one TypeScript v2 example showing export + retention metadata? Also show a minimal JSON example of redacted export for PII.

SDK Bot: Example TypeScript v2 snippet (suggested):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const resp = await client.audit.exports.create({
  start: '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z',
  end: '2025-12-31T23:59:59Z',
  retention_metadata: { retain_until: '2031-01-01T00:00:00Z', exported_by: 'team-platform' }
});
console.log(resp.download_url);
```

Jules Park: Nice. For curl, show an Authorization header and note the Content-Type: application/json.

Nina Gomez: Add this curl snippet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"start":"2025-01-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2025-02-01T00:00:00Z","retention_metadata":{"retain_until":"2031-01-01T00:00:00Z","control_area":"access_logs"}}'
```

Samir Khanna: Great. Now legal asked to add a short section on key management differences. Proposed sentence: "Hosted: data encrypted in transit and at rest; key management is handled by Redwood. Private deployments can integrate with customer KMS/HSM for key control." Keep concise.

Legal Bot: Approved phrase. Add a parenthetical: "(contact sales for dedicated KMS options)" if you want to be explicit for enterprise customers.

Jules Park: One more docs nit: add an internal cross-link to the retention policy doc and fix the broken anchor we found. Current link in `docs/security/audit.md` points to `#retention-periods` but the heading is `Retention guidance`. I'll update the anchor in the PR.

Docs Bot: Pull request opened: #1423 1 files changed 1 additions (docs/security/evidence-exports.md) :github:

Nina Gomez: Also include a short JSON export sample that shows redaction pattern for PII so auditors see best practices. Example:
```json
{ "event":"user.api_key.create", "actor":"REDACTED:user-****", "ip":"REDACTED", "meta":{"note":"redacted_for_privacy","exported_by":"team-platform" } }
```

Samir Khanna: Perfect. Action items: Jules fix anchor and migration note; Nina add curl + redaction JSON; I'll add the TS snippet and the hosted/private KMS sentence; Legal to do a final read before we merge. I'll ping the reviewers after updates.

Legal Bot: I'll review once the PR contains the recommended language and adds the 3-year baseline guidance.

Docs Bot: Reminder: please ensure the PR includes a changelog entry under docs/whats-new for transparency.

Samir Khanna: Done for now, thanks everyone. I'll update the PR and ping. :rocket:
